reason: E2 supports the premise that non-equilibrium processing can produce a metastable solid solution in Mg alloys with Ti and Zn, but it does not provide evidence for the subsequent transformation pathway, the specific role of Ti-rich precipitates, or the link to oxide passivation. E1 and E3 describe phase decomposition and intermetallic coarsening in different alloy systems (FeCrNiAl and refractory superalloys) without Mg, so they do not directly support the Mg-specific segregation, Ti-rich precipitate formation, or the proposed corrosion/oxidation mechanism.
